name: CF BypTest
description: Bypass-call probe (docs/helpers/FW_RND_S9_BYPASS_2026-10-22.md): ON passes the guitar unchanged; OFF adds a quiet 880 Hz beep scaled by (1 - fade). A beep while the effect is switched off proves the firmware keeps calling a bypassed effect, so delay tails need no firmware patch. Never save it in a patch.

params.name: Beep
params.explanation: Beep level heard while the effect is OFF (0 = silent).
